title: 03 · Sorrelby: recipe detail
strengths: A real idea carried into product terms: magazine furniture (masthead 'Larder No. 14', the 'AUTUMN SUPPERS' rule, a 'Fig. 1' caption, a kicker) around a working recipe screen with a servings stepper, a checklist and a pinned step timer.
A real, credited photograph instead of generated art, and the data agrees with it: 600 g cherry tomatoes on the vine, 2 jars butter beans 'keep the liquor', step 3 of 6 'Simmer, lid off', 12:40.
Type discipline: two faces, five sizes, the title split by weight (bold phrase, light rest) rather than italics or colour; one red for masthead, kicker and timer only.
slop_signals: Checked ingredients strike through both quantity and name in a heavy grey line; Kitchen Stories and Julienne mark done with the check alone.
'ONE POT · P. 32' is a page reference in an app: a conceit rather than a product detail.
fixes: Drop the strikethrough and let the check plus a lighter colour mark done rows.
Replace 'P. 32' with something the app knows (the section only, or prep time).

references.what: Serif title, a four-fact row (skill, time, ingredients, calories), ingredient checks and a cook action: the same order, plainer.
Quantity-first rows on hairlines with the servings stepper on the header line; done rows are not struck through.
Photo, title, a credit line for the source, large checks on ingredients.
Servings stepper with quantities in bold and names regular, the same row grammar.

changed: Fonts: Fraunces + Libre Franklin replaced by Literata (display) + Schibsted Grotesk (text) through the engine; iOS roles 34/22/17/15/13, weights 400-500
Spacing: everything on the 20/370 margins, 24 pt between groups, 52 pt rows; folio rules, 'Fig. 1' caption and 'p. 32' removed
Photo edge to edge under the status bar with a scrim (status clock 5.3:1, icons 3.3:1 at the brightest pixels); knife logos cropped out
One accent: tomato red only on 'Start cooking'; olive and mustard removed; neutral off-white page instead of cream with brown ink
The running step timer (contradicted the unticked list) replaced by a 6-step method bar sized by minutes: 15 hands-on + 40 waiting = 55
Done rows: quiet grey-filled check, tertiary text, no strikethrough
Fresh-eyes audit: 3/5, 3/5, then 4/5; its polish items fixed

round4.pairwise: Final round: won against Julienne by 3, NYT Cooking by 3 and Noom by 3 (won every pairing in every round after the first). Fresh-eyes audit 3, 3, 3, 4.
changed: Renamed Larder (a live App Store recipe app) to Sorrelby; Potwell and Saltmoor rejected as near-names
Recipe rewritten to match the photo: Butter beans with red peppers and tomato, 8 ingredients, 50 min, 25 hands-on, 6 steps
Fonts: Source Serif 4 (title 34 regular, section head, headnote) and Instrument Sans; five sizes
Spacing: 20 pt margins, 4 pt grid; three-column fact row; quantity column aligned to it, no row rules
One accent: tomato red only on 'Start cooking · 6 steps' in a blurred bottom bar; bordered servings stepper in the Ingredients header
Photo credit moved to the page foot; recipe shown saved; headnote in the quarterly's voice
Status bar contrast over the photo 6.2:1 (clock) and 5.0:1 (icons)
